card.name: Words leading into criticism
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected term for criticism or denouncing, such as 'nothing' before 'against', 'den' before 'ounce', or 'target of'. It fires in general web prose about attacks, complaints and condemnation.

modes.label: Partway into denounce/gripe
modes.description: Start of a verb of complaint or condemnation, cut off before it is finished.

modes.label: Setup for criticism
modes.description: A word that sets up an object or direction of criticism, such as against, of, or as a.
modes.example: was the target<< of>> one of Lenin’s most venomous pole

modes.label: Adjective before a report or critique
modes.description: A word describing an attack or harsh assessment as it builds up.
modes.example: a tremendously bitter and<< accurate>> report for the U.S. National Museum

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning criticism or critique, such as criticism, critique and criticize.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to say someone is being criticized or condemned.
